title: Light theme: SDUI text is effectively invisible (contrast 1.07-1.22:1)
evidence: screenshots/step1-light-1280x800.png; reports/evidence/pixel-evidence.txt (text rgb(15,23,42) on card rgb(28,28,35))
rootCause: SduiStepHost.vue hardcodes dark glass panel backgrounds (rgba(18,18,24,0.72) / rgba(26,26,34,0.75)) while the light theme switches --text-main to dark navy rgb(15,23,42).
fix: Use theme-aware CSS variables for glass background and text in SduiStepHost.vue; ensure light theme pairs light glass with dark text.

title: Tall wizard steps are clipped with no scroll (steps 3, 5, 6)
rootCause: .content-wrapper (App.vue:749-758) and .installer-app (App.vue:493) both set overflow:hidden; no intermediate scroll container.
actual: Step 6 content bottom 1769px in a 768px viewport; step 5 1216px; step 3 821px at 1024/1280
fix: Make .content-wrapper overflow-y:auto (or allow the step host to scroll) so tall steps are reachable.

title: Secondary text below WCAG AA in Dark and OLED themes
component: packages/fastfree_lowcode SDUI styles + installer theme tokens
rootCause: Blue secondary text and rgba(0,0,0,0.6) labels on dark glass cards are below the 4.5:1 AA threshold for normal text.
fix: Raise secondary text tokens to >=4.5:1 on dark backgrounds; replace rgba(0,0,0,0.6) label color with a light muted token.

title: Unrendered SDUI template placeholders displayed to users
rootCause: {{ state.* }} mustache bindings are not interpolated by the SDUI runtime for these schemas.
fix: Implement state interpolation in the SDUI runtime and add a regression test asserting no '{{' remains in rendered text.

title: Glass panel background not theme-aware (root cause of DEF-001)
evidence: reports/audit-report.json glass metrics (identical rgba(18,18,24,0.72) in all themes)
rootCause: Scoped CSS hardcodes dark RGBA values in SduiStepHost.vue lines 213-235 instead of using theme CSS variables.
expected: Glass panels follow the active theme
actual: Panels remain dark in Light and OLED themes
fix: Replace hardcoded RGBA with var(--glass-bg) / var(--glass-border) theme tokens.
